column3: Close to the Hebrew; מַשָּׂא (“oracle”) is rendered “The burden against.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the house” is rendered “the temple,” and “diminished” “cut off.”
Close to the Hebrew; “going down in weeping” is rendered “weeping bitterly.”
Close to the Hebrew; “its soul trembles to it” is rendered “His life will be burdensome to him.”
NKJV renders the place name Eglath Shelishiyah as “Like a three-year-old heifer,” and supplies “shall flee.”
Close to the Hebrew; “wastes” is rendered “desolate.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the wadi of the poplars” is rendered “the Brook of the Willows.”
Close to the Hebrew; “added things” is rendered “more,” and “a lion” “Lions.”
